title: About Gabi
intro: Fifteen years ago, as a side business and to fulfill an incurable itch for expressing her creativity through exciting house projects, Gabi got into residential real estate.

brings.heading: What she brings to every house
brings.text: Gabi brings a sense of awe to every project — she treats each home as though she's building the one of her own dreams.

paragraphs: Gabi Dalnekoff is a Brazilian-born business woman with a drive for living a multifaceted life. She has excelled in the corporate world, often building entirely new companies from the ground up. Real estate began as a side business — and she's been buying, renovating and upgrading her portfolio ever since, crediting it with the freedom to make her own schedule and live life on her terms.

She splits her time between Charleston, SC, and Highlands, NC, and is passionate about fitness and wellness. An accomplished tennis player, she competed internationally representing Brazil — and today, in addition to hitting tennis balls, she's a certified yoga and meditation instructor, guiding others through balancing physical, mental and daily challenges.
